landing.heroTitle1: You know how much a trade could lose.
landing.heroTitle2: Do you know what you could be liable for?
landing.heroSubEn: Understand the risk. Before it becomes your reality.
landing.heroDesc: Financial risk simulation, a legal rules engine and plain-language AI help you understand the financial and legal consequences of margin and day trading.
landing.noLogin: No sign-in needed. Numbers are computed by code; the AI never gives trading advice.
landing.previewTitle: Drag the price and see what happens
landing.previewDesc: Example: 1,000 shares bought at 100 with 60% financing (fictional demo)
landing.hiddenDesc: Leverage amplifies losses and legal obligations, not just gains.

principal: Falling prices come out of your own funds first; financing magnifies the percentage.
call: If the maintenance ratio falls below the threshold, the broker notifies you to top up within a deadline.
disposal: If you do not top up in time, the broker disposes of collateral under the rules.
debt: If disposal proceeds do not cover the loan, you still owe the difference.
unmatched: Unsold shares settle in full; unbought short sales are forcibly bought in.
settlement: Without enough funds by the settlement date, handling follows the rules and your contract.

twin: Virtual accounts that track financial, legal, contract and timeline state together.
risk: Decimal-precise maintenance ratio, top-up amount, costs and remaining debt.
timeline: The rules engine derives events and deadlines from business days and notice dates.
contract: Extracts original clauses, pages, rights and obligations — never invents missing terms.
rac: Official articles become versioned, testable rules, activated only after human review.
agents: Calculation, retrieval, verification, explanation and review — every step auditable.

howDesc: Enter trade parameters or upload a contract
Rules engine finds events and deadlines
trust: Numbers come from code; the AI cannot change them
Legal texts come from official sources with version and retrieval time
No trading advice and no price predictions
Rules are versioned; history keeps the version used at the time
Every number shows its formula and assumptions
Privacy reminder before upload; private data is visible only to you
landing.footerLimits: AI limitations: results are simulations for education and may be incomplete; broker notices, contracts and regulators prevail.
